Lucky Cement Ltd Launches New High-Performance Cement for Infrastructure Projects

Lucky Cement Ltd, a leading player in Pakistan’s construction materials sector, has announced the launch of its latest high-performance cement, designed specifically for large-scale infrastructure projects. The new product, branded as "Lucky SuperStrength," was unveiled at a launch event held at the company’s Karachi headquarters on Thursday.

According to company officials, Lucky SuperStrength has been engineered to provide enhanced durability and early strength development, meeting the evolving needs of the country’s construction industry. “With urban development on the rise and an increasing focus on mega-projects, we saw a clear need for a cement that delivers higher performance and reliability,” said Farhan Ali, Head of Product Development at Lucky Cement Ltd. “Our teams have worked extensively to ensure this product meets both local and international standards.”

Industry analysts believe the launch is well-timed given Pakistan’s ongoing investments in infrastructure, including highways, bridges, and energy projects. “The construction sector is expanding rapidly and demands materials that can withstand challenging environmental conditions,” noted Shazia Qureshi, a cement industry consultant. “Lucky Cement’s new product addresses a key market gap.”

The Pakistan Construction Materials Association welcomed the move, highlighting the importance of innovation in supporting national development goals. “High-quality materials are essential for sustainable growth,” said Association Secretary Imran Siddiqui. “Initiatives like this help raise industry benchmarks.”

Lucky Cement Ltd reported that initial shipments of Lucky SuperStrength will be directed toward strategic partners, including large contractors and government projects, with broader market availability expected by the end of the quarter. The company has also initiated a series of technical workshops to familiarize engineers and construction firms with the product’s applications.

The launch underlines Lucky Cement Ltd’s ongoing commitment to product innovation and supporting Pakistan’s infrastructure ambitions.
